title: Library Lion
author: Michelle Knudsen
intro: Miss Merriweather is the head librarian. She is very particular about the library rules.
checkedAgainst: Storyline Online page and teacher guide

questions.yes: Miss Merriweather is the head librarian.

questions.q: Who comes into the library one day?
questions.clue: He has a big mane and a loud roar.
questions.yes: One day, a lion came to the library.

questions.q: Who runs to tell Miss Merriweather about the lion?
questions.clue: He works in the library too.
questions.yes: Mr. McBee ran to tell Miss Merriweather.

questions.q: What does Miss Merriweather say when Mr. McBee runs in?
questions.clue: Running is against the library rules.

questions.q: Why does Miss Merriweather let the lion stay?
questions.clue: There are no rules about lions in the library.
questions.yes: The lion wasn't breaking any rules, so she let him stay.

questions.q: Where in the library does the lion go?
questions.clue: The children are listening to stories there.
questions.yes: The lion went to story hour.

questions.q: What does the lion do for the children at story hour?
questions.yes: The lion made a comfy backrest for the children.

questions.q: What must the lion do to stay in the library?
questions.yes: The lion had to be quiet, or he would have to leave.

questions.q: What does the lion do with his tail?
questions.clue: It gets rid of the dust.
questions.yes: The lion dusted with his tail.

questions.q: Who is unhappy about the lion being in the library?
questions.clue: He thinks lions do not belong in the library.
questions.yes: Mr. McBee did not like the lion being there.

options.text: She falls and breaks her arm

questions.yes: Miss Merriweather fell and broke her arm.

questions.clue: Miss Merriweather is hurt and needs someone.
questions.yes: The lion roared to get help for Miss Merriweather.

questions.q: Why does the lion stay away from the library?
questions.yes: The lion stayed away because he had broken a rule.

questions.q: Who goes out to look for the lion?
questions.clue: It is the man who did not like the lion at first.
questions.yes: Mr. McBee went out to find the lion.

questions.q: What does Mr. McBee tell the lion?

options.text: Sometimes it's OK to break a rule
Lions must stay at the zoo

questions.clue: Roaring for help was the right thing to do.
questions.yes: Mr. McBee said there is sometimes a good reason to break a rule.
